subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#4 requires tests covering: (1) live_preview block present with preview_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, (2) live_preview absent when the token is unset. The diff only adds one test (forwarding preview_hash through getEntry to addParam). The setHost priority test (AC#4 scenario 3) appears to already exist at ~line 476, but no tests for scenarios (1) and (2) are visible in the diff or in the first ~300 lines of the test file. Prior review feedback explicitly flagged these as missing. Without these tests, AC#4 is not met.
issues.suggestedFix: Add two tests: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN in process.env, require the module, and assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, preview_token: '<token>' }; (2) unset CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require the module, and assert options does not have a live_preview property (use expect(options).not.toHaveProperty('live_preview')).

issues.description: The forwarding test only covers getEntry. While getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, and findSingletonEntry all destructure and forward live_preview (verified in contentstack.ts), the test only exercises one path. A regression that removes forwarding from any other public function would not be caught. Prior review rules require proof that preview context flows through public functions to setCommonConfig.
issues.suggestedFix: Add at least one additional test that calls getSingleEntry (or another public function) with a live_preview parameter and asserts addParam was called with the correct preview_hash value. This proves the forwarding pattern works end-to-end across multiple call paths.

issues.description: Cannot verify getSingletonEntry forwards live_preview — file was truncated at line ~410. The learned review rules specifically flag getSingletonEntry as one of the public functions that must destructure and forward live_preview. If it does not, AC#3 is not met (preview context cannot flow through all public query paths).
issues.suggestedFix: Verify getSingletonEntry destructures live_preview from its parameters and forwards it to createContentTypeQuery or createContentTypeEntryQuery. If it does not, add live_preview to its destructuring and pass it through to the factory method call.

issues.description: jest.spyOn(Stack, "addParam" as any) uses an explicit `as any` cast. While the source file has an eslint-disable for no-explicit-any, the test file does not. This is a TypeScript strict compliance concern.
issues.suggestedFix: Type the spy properly or add an eslint-disable comment with explanation, consistent with the codebase pattern.
